title: Spaghetti Game 2: The Monster Within
tagline: Spaghetti Game 2: The Monster Within is a game which randomly generates a single level every day based on the blockchain.
description: Spaghetti Game 2: The Monster Within is a game where each level is generated randomly similarly to the Blockchain. You play as Froodle and harm the Moople in order to get speed and have more fun. The objective of the game is to beat the level as fast as possible but the real objective is to have fun.
how_its_made: We used Phaser to build the game. We hosted it on Lighthouse and Valist. It was built with Typescript and we used Github to collaborate. As well the sprites were designed within Aseprite and we had multiple layers and frames for our animations. Lastly the music was made in Garageband and we used multiple instruments.
